Measured production source HEAD 00fa00d7d93dba2fb38dbb6d9e60a85cb24d799f.
Release build: cargo build --release --locked, default release profile, no RUSTFLAGS override.
LIBRARY_PATH=LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/image-vips/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
VIPSHOME=/tmp/image-vips/usr/lib
Rust binding libvips 2.3.0 dynamically links Ubuntu libvips 8.18.0.
Extracted libwebp 1.5.0, libjpeg-turbo 2.1.5.
System libheif 1.21.2, AOM 3.13.1, PNG 1.6.57, librsvg 2.61.3.
Sharp 0.35.5 bundles libvips 8.18.7, libheif 1.23.5, AOM 3.15.1, PNG 1.6.58,
librsvg 2.63.2, WebP 1.6.0, mozjpeg 0826579 and zlib-ng 2.3.3.
Different native versions/builds prevent attributing differences solely to Rust versus Node.
Both process files and variants sequentially, cache disabled, libvips concurrency 1.
Both use auto-orientation, no enlargement, Lanczos3, SVG density 72, stripped metadata.
Rust uses thumbnail shrink-on-load and fail-on-warning, validates containers, writes temporary
outputs, sync_all and atomic no-clobber publication. Sharp writes directly without fsync.
WebP Q80 effort6 alphaQ100 lossy, no near-lossless/smart-subsampling; native default preset.
JPEG Q80 baseline optimized Huffman, native AUTO at Q80 equals Sharp explicit 4:2:0.
PNG compression6 all filters, no palette. AVIF Q80 effort6 AV1 8-bit lossy;
native AUTO at Q80 equals 4:2:0. Native AOM default tune SSIM, Sharp now explicit SSIM.
Before final run, reference AVIF changed 4:4:4 to 4:2:0 and auto tune to SSIM;
JPEG optimized coding made explicit. PNG adaptiveFiltering=true was already fixed before run.
Evidence: installed sharp/src/pipeline.cc and dist/constructor.mjs; native headers and operation help;
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libvips/libvips/v8.18.0/libvips/foreign/heifsave.c
heifsave.c lines 600-640 map effort to speed=9-effort, select 420 at Q<90,
and clip encoder threads to vips_concurrency_get().
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/strukturag/libheif/v1.21.2/libheif/plugins/encoder_aom.cc
encoder_aom.cc default tune SSIM. JPEG native AUTO disables subsampling only at Q>=90.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libvips/libvips/v8.18.0/libvips/foreign/jpegsave.c
Thread environment SHARP_IGNORE_GLOBAL_LIBVIPS=1, UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=VIPS_CONCURRENCY=
RAYON_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. Not CPU affinity or an OS CPU quota.
Profile and output quality evidence collected separately after timed runs.
Sharp convert loops files and widths without expectations metadata probes. Verification runs afterward.
Wall clock stops immediately after process.wait(), before watchdog cancel/join.
EXIF6 case derives a 1600x1000 crop from earth.jpg, JPEG Q92 with orientation 6.
Exploratory fixed-comparison was interrupted after review. Candidate fixed-comparison-v3 has 21 cases.

binary.help:
Convert static JPEG, PNG, AVIF, and self-contained SVG images with libvips

Usage: image-optimizer [OPTIONS] <INPUT>

Arguments:
  <INPUT>  Source file or directory. Symlinks are not followed

Options:
      --out-dir <OUT_DIR>        Destination tree. Original filenames and relative directories are retained
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>          Exact destination for one source and one variant. Format is selected by --format
      --recursive                Include subdirectories, excluding the destination tree
      --width <WIDTH>            Fit within this width without cropping
      --widths <WIDTHS>          Comma-separated srcset widths, at most 32 unique values
      --height <HEIGHT>          Fit within this height, optionally combined with width
      --format <FORMAT>          Output encoding. Preserve reencodes rasters or resizes the SVG viewport [default: webp] [possible values: webp, preserve]
      --quality <QUALITY>        Lossy JPEG, AVIF, or WebP quality. PNG remains lossless [default: 80]
      --effort <EFFORT>          WebP/AVIF encoder effort or PNG compression, from 0 to 6 [default: 6]
      --cpu <CPU>                Libvips worker threads, not a hard process CPU cap [default: 1]
      --upscale                  Allow enlarging small inputs to the requested bounds
      --overwrite                Atomically replace existing regular outputs. Never replace input files
      --dry-run                  Plan outputs and inspect headers without writing or fully decoding pixels
      --json                     Print one schema-versioned JSON report to stdout
      --max-pixels <MAX_PIXELS>  Reject source or output images above this pixel count. Not a hard memory limit [default: 100000000]
  -h, --help                     Print help
  -V, --version                  Print version
